description: This file is a shell script that implements setup, teardown, and initialization functions for the 464xlat CLAT (Customer-side Translator) protocol in an OpenWRT environment, configuring IPv6 translation for network interfaces.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_setup
methods.description: Configures the network for 464xlat using provided configuration parameters, setting up IPv6 rules, routes, and firewall settings.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_teardown
methods.description: Removes the 464xlat configuration and associated network settings, cleaning up rules and temporary files.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_init_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration options for the 464xlat protocol, setting up necessary parameters and enabling the protocol.
